criteria.criterion: Moving-range findings identify variation changes separately from location changes.
criteria.notes: Adjacent standardized-residual differences produce variation_shift findings; the test checks magnitude, detection index, and interpretation.

review.intent_summary: The adaptive recipe updates each expectation from a bounded window of earlier observations while retaining frozen residual calibration.

criteria.criterion: Each rolling expectation uses only observations before the sample being scored.
criteria.notes: All rolling-reference positions precede the scored index. The independent expectation remains unchanged after future values are appended.

criteria.criterion: Persistent growth changes can be followed more closely than by the frozen default recipe.
criteria.notes: The test requires adaptive held-out MAE below half the frozen recipe's MAE and a close final expectation.

criteria.criterion: An isolated extreme value is held out of future model references rather than creating a seasonal echo.
criteria.notes: The isolated spike is excluded from model references; its next seasonal expectation closely matches the control. Persistent third misses are admitted as guidance explicitly permits.

criteria.criterion: Conflicting trend choices and slope lookbacks exceeding the adaptive window are rejected.
criteria.notes: Both incompatible explicit trend selection and excessive slope lookback raise specific validation errors.
